report: Independently reviewed the complete current claim, sole implementation entry and complete associated test, including their enclosing service_spec.rs TODO module. Verified both historical source snapshots exactly match current source; the prior rationale remains applicable. The claim requires evidence local to each architectural claim, behavior-matching evidence for positive capability statements, permits negative/partial artifacts to document limitations, and forbids inferring an unstated local guarantee from aggregate suite success. Its documentation-review scenario covers every implemented capability using focused tests, snapshots, normalized traces, edit experiments, exact oracle results, inspector scenarios, or source anchors. The implementation TODO explicitly acknowledges incomplete claim-specific evidence for positive capabilities in supporting prose. The sole test, todo::meta_validation_claim_specific_evidence, explicitly defers associating and reviewing the complete behavior-matching evidence inventory and lists all seven scenario artifact types. Its empty body makes no assertions and cannot detect a falsely established local guarantee; it is accepted only as declared TODO, not behavioral coverage. Completing the capability inventory and attaching/reviewing focused matching positive or limitation evidence are prerequisites to claiming this contract implemented. This accounts for all claim aspects as deferred; neither existing automatic reviews nor aggregate success establish completeness. No N/A or ordinary evidence entries exist. Read the review policy through review read. This was source inspection and historical byte comparison; I ran review start/read/record commands, no behavior tests or broad builds. Coordinator-reported suite/build success is separate execution evidence and is not used to approve a local guarantee. No source edits are requested for this explicitly documented deferral.
